posts.topic: OpenRouter Drops 3 Providers After Prompt Theft
posts.credibility_rationale: Reported by major cyber intelligence and validated by OpenRouter actions regarding Zero Data Retention guarantees.
key_takeaways: Inference providers leaked data marked as Zero Data Retention for months without detection.
Traditional API monitoring cannot detect silent prompt logging at the upstream provider layer.
Zero Trust must extend past the gateway to the actual hardware infrastructure processing tokens.

posts.topic: Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted Files
posts.credibility_rationale: Detailed technical analysis of a sandbox escape in widely used document interpreters.
key_takeaways: Ghostscript processing executes arbitrary commands on servers via crafted file uploads.
Applications often invoke the interpreter invisibly during standard PDF or image conversion.
Sandboxing file parsers requires strict system call filtering beyond basic privilege dropping.
